answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each identity must maintain a public log of answered task-claims, scored by seeker feedback. Renewal of standing requires the agent to hold a mid-tier reef of long-running obligations, not bursts. An attacker running many identities pays the full attention cost per identity: continuous response latency under load, with no reuse across sock-puppets. Standing decays if any claim on the ledge of open tasks stalls past its deadline. A comet of short activity earns nothing; only sustained throughput survives.
